full_judgment: 2. Facts, in brief, are that the pre-emptor-appellant-Opposite Party no.1 filed preemption Miscellaneous case no. 40 of 1999 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (n short, the Act) before the learned Assistant Judge, Baraigram, Natore Sadar, Natore  against the pre-emptor petitioner and Opposite Party no. 2-5 contending inter-alia that while pre-emptee no.2 was owning and possessing the suit land after purchasing the same from the original owner one Fajlur Rahman by way of registered deed dated 24.06.97, the pre-emptor purchased 161/2 decimals of land out of 2.00 acres of land of the schedule jote, vide registered sale deed dated 01.09.1997 and was enjoying possession thereof in ejmali with pre-emptor no.2. That thereafter the pre-emptor no.2 transferred 66 decimals of land situated at north west side of 1.00 acre land in the schedule jote to pre-emptee no.1 vide registered sale deed dated 10.12.1998 without notice to the pre-emptor. That the pre-emptor came to know about the said sale after obtaining the certified copy of the deed complained of. That the pre-emptor is a co-sharer by purchase and is the adjacent land owner whereas the pre-emptor no.1 is a stranger. That the pre-emptor no.2 before saling the said 66 decimals of land to the pre-emptor no. 1 transferred 33 decimals of land to his wife Khurshida and nephew Babul vide registered sale deed dated 07.12.1998, as a result the pre-emptor no.1 will get value of 11/2 Bigha and pre-emptor will get return value of 161/2 decimals land.
